description: Home Assistant OS as reported by haos-exporter: Supervisor health, versions, apps, backups, the host and the exporter itself.

panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the exporter right now.
panels.title: Exporter

panels.description: The Supervisor's own health flag. When it reads Unhealthy, the Resolution center panel says why.
panels.title: Supervisor

panels.description: Whether the Supervisor considers this installation supported. Unsupported reasons appear in the Resolution center panel.
panels.title: Installation

panels.description: Whether Core's web server answers an unauthenticated GET /manifest.json. The exporter keeps reporting while Core is down.
panels.title: Core

panels.description: Pending updates for Core, Supervisor, OS and apps together.
panels.title: Updates

panels.description: Free space on the data partition. Below 2 GiB the Supervisor refuses updates, backups and app installs.
panels.title: Data disk

panels.description: Age of the newest backup of any type. Empty when there is no backup, or while the backups poll is failing.
panels.title: Last backup

panels.description: The exporter's start-up checks: non-root, no capabilities, AppArmor enforced and blocking a write, and a manager-only Supervisor path refused.
panels.title: Self-check

panels.description: Installed and latest versions as the Supervisor reports them.
panels.title: Versions

panels.description: Issues, suggestions, and unhealthy or unsupported reasons from the Supervisor's resolution center.
panels.title: Resolution center

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (type, context) (haos_resolution_issues{job="$job", instance="$instance"}), "kind", "Issue", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (type, context) (haos_resolution_suggestions{job="$job", instance="$instance"}), "kind", "Suggestion", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (reason) (haos_resolution_unhealthy{job="$job", instance="$instance"}), "type", "$1", "reason", "(.+)"), "kind", "Unhealthy", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(max by (reason) (haos_resolution_unsupported{job="$job", instance="$instance"}), "type", "$1", "reason", "(.+)"), "kind", "Unsupported", "", "") or on() label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "kind", "None", "", ""), "type", "nothing reported", "", "")

panels.description: The OS's A/B boot slots: the booted slot and the fallback.
panels.title: Boot slots

targets.expr: max by (slot, state, status, version) (haos_os_boot_slot_info{job="$job", instance="$instance"})

panels.description: Every installed app with its state and version.
panels.title: Installed apps

targets.expr: max by (slug, name, version, version_latest) (haos_app_info{job="$job", instance="$instance"})

panels.description: Each app's state over time.
panels.title: App states

targets.expr:
max by (name) ((
    (haos_app_state{job="$job", instance="$instance", state="started"} == 1) * 0
  or (haos_app_state{job="$job", instance="$instance", state="startup"} == 1) * 1
  or (haos_app_state{job="$job", instance="$instance", state="stopped"} == 1) * 2
  or (haos_app_state{job="$job", instance="$instance", state="error"} == 1) * 3
  or (haos_app_state{job="$job", instance="$instance", state="unknown"} == 1) * 4
) * on (slug) group_left (name) max by (slug, name) (haos_app_info{job="$job", instance="$instance"}))

panels.description: Pending updates by kind. Apps are counted together.
panels.title: Pending updates

panels.description: Backup count, total size and newest backup per type.
panels.title: Backups

panels.description: Age of the newest backup. The dashed line is two days.
panels.title: Newest backup age

panels.description: CPU time by mode, as a share of all CPUs.
panels.title: CPU

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="$job", instance="$instance", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="$job", instance="$instance", mode="idle"}))

panels.description: Memory in use (total minus available), swap in use, and total memory.
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: Load averages, with the CPU count for scale.
panels.title: Load

panels.description: Free space on the data partition. Dashed lines: 2 GiB, below which the Supervisor refuses updates, backups and app installs, and 5 GiB.
panels.title: Data disk free

panels.description: Bytes read (up) and written (down) per whole disk.
panels.title: Disk throughput

panels.description: Share of time tasks waited on CPU, memory or IO (Linux pressure stall information). "Some": at least one task waited; "full": all non-idle tasks did.
panels.title: Pressure stalls

panels.description: Whether each collector's last run succeeded. The Supervisor collectors poll in the background; the others run on every scrape.
panels.title: Collectors

panels.description: Time since each Supervisor poll last succeeded, in multiples of its poll interval. It stays near or below 1 while polls succeed; at 3 a poll has missed two rounds, a sensible alert threshold. The Collectors timeline shows the history.
panels.title: Supervisor poll age

panels.description: How long each collector's last run took, on a log scale. A failing Supervisor call can take up to its 5 s timeout.
panels.title: Collector duration

panels.description: The exporter's start-up checks of its own confinement. Diagnostics, not proof: see the README.
panels.title: Security self-check

panels.description: The running exporter's version.
panels.title: Exporter version

panels.description: The tls_mode option, and whether a client certificate is required (tls_client_auth).
panels.title: TLS

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(max by (mode, client_auth) (haos_exporter_tls_info{job="$job", instance="$instance"}), "client_auth", "client certificate required", "client_auth", "true"), "client_auth", "no client certificate", "client_auth", "false")

panels.description: Expiry of the provided server certificate. Absent with tls_mode self_signed, whose certificate is new at every start.
panels.title: Certificate expires

panels.description: Series dropped by the exporter's cardinality caps or for an invalid app slug, since it started.
panels.title: Series dropped

title: Home Assistant OS
